capabilities: Run a Kanban board where each card is a plain Markdown file
Drag and drop cards between columns with persistent fractional ordering
Nest subcards and checklist subitems that can claim their own column
Track comments, unread markers, assignments, and automatic history on cards
Expose board operations to AI agents through a local MCP server
extras: Desktop only (macOS and Linux for agent columns); phones and tablets are not supported. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+. The Agents in columns feature is experimental and off by default. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Kanban board, so managing task cards across notes lacks a board view with persistent ordering, subcards, and comment tracking.

relations.evidence: By default that is a Claude Code session in a window of the plugin's own tmux server

requires.name: Claude Code (and tmux) for the Agents in columns feature; an MCP client for agent access

summary: Kanban board plugin that stores every card as a plain Markdown file, with drag-and-drop, nested subcards, comments, and history.
